integrity: The infinite theorem is proved analytically. The included exact enumeration is corroborative and uses Gaussian-integer arithmetic; no floating-point tolerance is used.
scientific_limitations: Only three-point supports in powers of \(\mathbb Z_4\) are classified; coefficient-locus geometry and larger supports are not addressed.
title: Three-sparse Fourier support is controlled by affine span on \(\mathbb Z_4^d\)
